question: How much does replacing PVDF with PVDF latex and CMC raise the solids content of NMC 532 slurries, and by what share does the higher solids content cut the primary drying time of the graphite coating?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page = 8 AND (text ILIKE '%drying time%' OR text ILIKE '%solid con%' OR text ILIKE '%51 s%' OR text ILIKE '%34 s%' OR text ILIKE '%65 wt%')

WITH a AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'from (\d+)',1) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L34'),
b AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'to (\d+) s',1) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L35'),
s AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'from (\d+) wt%',1) AS DOUBLE) AS lo, CAST(regexp_extract(text,'to (\d+) wt%',1) AS DOUBLE) AS hi FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L32')
SELECT (s.hi - s.lo) AS solids_gain_points, s.hi/s.lo AS solids_ratio, (a.v - b.v)/a.v AS drying_cut_fraction, a.v AS old_s, b.v AS new_s FROM a, b, s
